recipes.title: Gujarati Dhokla
recipes.ingredients: Besan, lemon juice, Eno, salt, sugar, water
recipes.instructions: Prepare the batter, add Eno, steam for 15 minutes, and garnish with mustard seeds.

recipes.title: Paneer Butter Masala
recipes.instructions: Prepare tomato gravy, add paneer and cream, and simmer until cooked.

recipes.title: Veg Fried Rice
recipes.ingredients: Rice, carrots, capsicum, peas, soy sauce
recipes.instructions: Stir-fry the vegetables, add cooked rice and soy sauce, and mix well.
